abilities.name: Direct Punch
abilities.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to 1% of Luka's ATK to a single enemy.

abilities.name: Lacerating Fist
abilities.text:
Deals Physical DMG equal to 1.2% of Luka's ATK to a single enemy target. In addition, there is a 1% base chance to inflict Bleed on them, lasting for 3 turn(s).
While Bleeding, the enemy will take 0.24% of their Max HP as Physical DoT at the start of each turn. This DMG will not exceed more than 3.38% of Luka's ATK.

abilities.name: Coup de Grâce
abilities.text: Receives 2 stack(s) of Fighting Will, with a 1% base chance to increase a single enemy target's DMG received by 0.2% for 3 turn(s). Then, deals Physical DMG equal to 3.3% of Luka's ATK to the target.

abilities.name: Flying Sparks
abilities.text: After Luka uses his Basic ATK "Direct Punch" or Skill "Lacerating Fist," he receives 1 stack of Fighting Will, up to 4 stacks. When he has 2 or more stacks of Fighting Will, his Basic ATK "Direct Punch" is enhanced to "Sky-Shatter Fist." After his Enhanced Basic ATK's "Rising Uppercut" hits a Bleeding enemy target, the Bleed status will immediately deal DMG for 1 time equal to 0.85% of the original DMG to the target. At the start of battle, Luka will possess 1 stack of Fighting Will.

abilities.name: Anticipator
abilities.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Luka deals Physical DMG equal to 0.5% of his ATK to a random single enemy with a 1% base chance to inflict his Skill's Bleed effect on the target. Then, Luka gains 1 additional stack of Fighting Will.

abilities.name: Kinetic Overload
abilities.desc: When the Skill is used, immediately dispels 1 buff from the enemy target.

abilities.name: Cycle Braking
abilities.desc: For every stack of Fighting Will obtained, additionally regenerates 3 Energy.

abilities.name: Crush Fighting Will
abilities.desc: When using Enhanced Basic ATK, every hit Direct Punch deals has a 50% fixed chance for Luka to use 1 additional hit. This effect does not apply to additional hits generated in this way.

abilities.name: Fighting Endlessly
abilities.desc: When Luka takes action, if the target enemy is Bleeding, increases DMG dealt by Luka by 15% for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: The Enemy is Weak, I am Strong
abilities.desc: If the Skill hits an enemy target with Physical Weakness, gain 1 stack(s) of Fighting Will.

abilities.name: Born for the Ring
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Never Turning Back
abilities.desc: For every stack of Fighting Will obtained, increases ATK by 5%, stacking up to 4 time(s).

abilities.name: The Spirit of Wildfire
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: A Champion's Applause
abilities.desc: After the Enhanced Basic ATK's "Rising Uppercut" hits a Bleeding enemy target, the Bleed status will immediately deal DMG 1 time equal to 8% of the original DMG for every hit of Direct Punch already unleashed during the current Enhanced Basic ATK.
